title: お出かけ後のお楽しみ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way home from an outing with Maruzensky…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Time really does fly when you're having fun… I'm not ready for the day to end!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, you too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, you too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: In that case… Since we're already out and about, let's take a little detour!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's kind of boring just to go straight home, you know?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Woo-hoo! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Can I decide where we go? There's something I've been wanting to try for a while now!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Follow me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: …Radical! They're still open!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I've always wanted to go to an amusement park in the evening!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky's goal is to visit just before closing time, when the park is almost empty.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's got that after-hours vibe. Hip, young people like to come at this time! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It'll be easier to get around with so few people. That means we can enjoy lots of rides!
choice_data_list: Is entering just before closing time really okay?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: No problemo! That's where you come in, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: No problemo! That's where you come in, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So, what kind of strategy do you think we should follow to have the most fun possible with our limited time?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ooh, and I definitely want to ride the roller coaster!
choice_data_list: Let's just go straight to the roller coaster!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Wh-whaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That plan… is the bomb!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: By focusing on just one thing, we'll get the most enjoyment out of our time! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I heard the roller coaster here is the fastest in the country, so it's perfect for this plan!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, you didn't know? Well, I'm sure it'll be like a walk in the park for you!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You're used to my driving, so this'll be nothing—probably!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You're used to my driving, so this'll be nothing—probably!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Now come on, before you change your mind! We're wasting time!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Let's go, go, GO! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We ride the roller coaster, and while I certainly feel like I've developed a tolerance for high speeds…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Trainer, are you okay? Can you stand up? Do you need me to carry you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Trainer, are you okay? Can you stand up? Do you need me to carry you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You shouldn't have pushed yourself so hard! Let's take a rest on one of the benches over there and then head home.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of us take some time to admire the amusement park as the remaining visitors continue to dissipate.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: A simple and straightforward strategy! I like it!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's going to be a test of stamina to see how much we can do…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I want to conquer all the rides! It may be a pretty rough road, though. Are you ready for that?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ooh, I love that energy! That's what I want to hear, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ooh, I love that energy! That's what I want to hear, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: All right, let's do this! Chaaarge!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Okay, we're halfway there! Now for the final sprint!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hang in there, Trainer! Let's get through this together!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hang in there, Trainer! Let's get through this together!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: We can do it! We're going to become amusement park legends!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky and I keep up the pace, rushing around the whole park… and somehow manage to ride all of the rides!
